name: Sparse Dual Marching Cubes
aliases: Sparse Dual Marching Cubes from Points
definition: Generates a quad-based mesh (quadmesh) from sparse voxel SDFs. Each active voxel generates a dual vertex at its center, and quads are formed by connecting dual vertices across shared marching cube edges.
summary: Sparse Dual Marching Cubes generates a quad-based mesh from sparse voxel Signed Distance Fields by placing dual vertices at voxel centers and connecting them across shared edges.
